This is a markdown version of the R script in_season_assessment_tusket.R.

I made this version because I find it is often useful to be able to tinker
with things in an Rmd versus a plain R script.

```{r}
# 
vd_path <- "R:/Science/Population Ecology Division/DFD/Alosa/Locations/Tusket River/Tusket 2025/data/Vaughan 2025 count data.csv"

ph_path <-
  
  escapement_vd <- onespecies.river.escapement(
      vd_path,
      fixtime = TRUE,
      downstream.migration = FALSE,
      database = FALSE,#when false, arguments below are not used
      year = "BUBBUS",#not used
      site = "BUBBUS",#not used
      channel = "BUBBUS"#not used
    )
```
